random_draw_order: For each trial 1..N-1: hinge position Gaussian vector, then full qvel Gaussian vector
trial_zero: Exact first reference guard pose and zero generalized velocity

reference_timing.timing_description: Nonuniform phase warp; 250ms borrowed from initial guard to lengthen the high-load swing; no uniform source-playback speed

scope: Paired small guard perturbations on the same punch reference; not held-out motion generalization
usage: Use these exact trial_ids and initial arrays for both classical baseline and learned controller; save every trial at every physics substep
evaluation_protocol: Post-selection fresh test bank; checkpoint hash frozen in selection.json before generation. Exact arrays not used for gradient training or checkpoint selection. Trial0 is the shared nominal anchor; trials1..63 new draws. Fixed-motion descriptive test, not population guarantee.
attack_window_semantics: derived: inserted launch through closest active-glove approach plus 150ms follow-through; not capture-reviewed
